selection_rule: calibration ranks four fixed profiles; top two eligible profiles validated; choose lowest validation score; test not generated until selection artifact is saved
objective: mean(trusted truth_exposure + 0.10 * distance / paired shortest distance) + 0.05 * mean(T1,T2 replay truth_exposure) + 0.002 * mean(T1,T2 replans)
eligibility: T1 must switch to a safer route and T2 must reduce replanning relative to always on calibration and validation seeds
replication_unit: scenario seed; OD, times and perturbations are paired repeated measurements, not independent samples
